citation.title: A Geometric-Enhanced Neural Network Method for Scalable and High-Resolution Topology Optimization
citation.authors: Lei Zhang, Shiqiang Li, Zhichu Lei, Guangzhe Du, Xiao Zhang, Guanbin Chen, Wenliang Qian (Crossref; OpenAlex and the pool list 'Li Zhang' and 'Xi Zhang')
citation.venue: Symmetry 18(3) 537 (MDPI; published 2026-03-21; CC BY 4.0 per Crossref)
citation.version_coded: none: abstract only (publisher-deposited abstract in Crossref metadata); full text not reachable

claim.primary_outcome_paraphrase: Not coded (abstract only). The abstract claims better computational efficiency than traditional and other neural-network TO methods, and a 256 m bridge with millions of DOFs optimized in under ten minutes on a standard PC; no comparison numbers are given.
